description: Renders one metric as a number that counts up to its target value. The FINAL formatted value is what the document contains — the animation only repaints that same text between frames — so a screen reader, a copy/paste and a host without JavaScript all get the exact number once. The ticker runs in a requestAnimationFrame loop (tm-animated-number.js) and is skipped entirely when the machine asks for reduced motion.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The numeric value to display. The rendered text is Value.ToString(Format, Culture) wrapped in Prefix/Suffix, so the number the reader receives is the culture-correct final value, never an intermediate frame.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The .NET numeric format string (default N0 — whole, group-separated numbers). It decides the final text and the shape of the intermediate frames: N/F/P/C and the custom 0/# patterns are mirrored by the ticker, while an unsupported format still animates and only its in-flight frames fall back to whole numbers. The last frame is always the exact string.Format result.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture the number is formatted with. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time, so a ticker follows the request culture without being told.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: Optional text before the number (a currency symbol, a sign). Host data — the component does not localize it.

parameters.name: Suffix
parameters.description: Optional text after the number (for example " %"). Host data — the component does not localize it.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Length of the ticker in milliseconds (default 600), clamped to 0–10000. 0 means instant: no JavaScript module is imported at all.

parameters.name: StartValue
parameters.description: The value the very first frame starts from. Null (the default) means 0. Later value changes never return here: a change that lands mid-animation retargets the running loop from the number currently on screen.

parameters.name: Animate
parameters.description: Whether the ticker runs at all. False is a pure-Blazor path with no module import and no motion-preference probe — for static exports, tests, or a host that wants a still number. Reduced motion is honoured independently of this switch.

parameters.name: Announce
parameters.description: Turns the accessible value into a polite, atomic live region so a changed number is announced once when it lands; the visual span then steps out of the accessibility tree, keeping the region the only text a reader meets. Default false: a page with many tickers must not become a chorus, and the value is readable without it.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the root data-testid; the default id is animated-number and TestIdPrefix namespaces it.

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces the component's internal test ids as "{prefix}-{name}" so several instances on one page stay targetable.
